html.faq.a1.en: Yes. You get 3 free readings every day; earn more that never expire through daily check-ins, sharing, and inviting friends.
html.faq.a1.zh: 免费。每天有 3 次免费占卜额度；通过每日签到、分享、邀请朋友还能赚更多，不会过期。

html.faq.a2.en: Every reading is generated live from the cards you drew (or your chart) and your question — never canned scripts; you can keep asking follow-ups.
html.faq.a2.zh: 每一次解读都结合你抽到的牌面（或排盘）和你的问题实时生成，不是固定的模板话术；看完还能继续追问。

html.faq.a3.en: Charts only need your birth date and time to calculate; you can delete your records in the journal anytime.
html.faq.a3.zh: 排盘只需要出生年月日时，用于计算命盘；你可以随时在占卜日记里删除记录。

html.faq.a4.en: Tarot and Chinese metaphysics are thousand-year-old traditions; Moonlit Tarot makes them your companion. Take them as inspiration and reference — important decisions are still yours to make. Traditional folklore, for entertainment.
html.faq.a4.zh: 塔罗和命理是流传千年的传统文化，月光塔罗把它做成陪伴你的方式。建议当作启发和参考，重要决定还是要自己拿主意 —— 传统民俗，仅供娱乐。

html.faq.a5.en: Three ways: ① check in daily to build your streak ② share readings with friends ③ invite friends — you each get +1.
html.faq.a5.zh: 三招：① 每日签到攒连续天数 ② 把解读分享给朋友 ③ 邀请朋友一起来，各得 +1 次。
